entries.name: 0bull
entries.description: Control real iPhones rented from 0bull (screenshots, on-screen text, taps, typing, device commands, recorded macros, an on-phone agent) and publish videos to TikTok and YouTube Shorts from them, through the hosted 0bull Streamable HTTP MCP server plus three workflow skills. Portable Agent Plugins v1 package (mcp.json + skills/), no plugin code. Requires a 0bull account with a rented phone and browser OAuth consent (add the server with auth: oauth, then hermes mcp login 0bull); no API key or client secret is stored in the plugin. Posting sends the user's video and caption to TikTok or YouTube through the phone's own apps. Disclosure — hosted-only connector; screenshots, on-screen text, anything typed on the phone (including passwords or codes you hand the agent) and your videos and captions go to 0bull.net; posts publish publicly to TikTok or YouTube; the server also exposes rental tools that spend money, which the skills tell the model never to call but Hermes does not block.

entries.name: accent-picker
entries.title: Accent Picker
entries.description: OKLCH accent colour picker for the Hermes Desktop status bar: drag it and the whole theme retints live, with palette commands to reset to the theme default or copy the current colour. A theme-authoring tool; the colour is scratch state and is never persisted. Desktop-only (desktop/plugin.js inside the plugin SDK surface); no agent tools, hooks, middleware or env vars.

entries.name: adaption
entries.title: Adaption
entries.description: Dataset import, adaptation, augmentation, translation, localization, synthetic generation (Invent), and AutoScientist fine-tuning through Adaption's hosted MCP server, with three workflow skills bundled. Agent Plugins v1 package (plugin.json + mcp.json + skills/), configuration only. Disclosure — every tool call goes to Adaption's hosted server (api.prod.adaptionlabs.ai) and acts on the user's Adaption account, tagged with a fixed hermes-plugin source parameter and header; the tool set is served by that server at runtime and is not covered by the pinned sha. Sign-in runs the pinned mcp-remote@0.1.49 through npx (Node.js 20.18.1+ and npm required; its own npm dependencies resolve to their latest matching versions at first run) with Adaption's pre-registered public OAuth client, which opens a browser and a local callback port on first use and stores OAuth tokens under ~/.mcp-auth. Launching runs spends Adaption credits; the package marks the server untrusted, so Hermes asks before every tool the server does not mark read-only (including cost estimates) and refuses them in unattended runs.

entries.name: 1toolring
entries.title: 1ToolRing
entries.description:
One API key and one prepaid balance for thousands of pay-per-call tools: search and SEO data, maps and places, shopping prices, market data, web pages, images, video, voice and more. Runs on 1ToolRing's hosted MCP server.

- Search and SEO: Google search results, keyword and SEO data
- Maps and places: Google Maps places
- Shopping: e-commerce product prices
- Also market data, web pages, images, video and voice, from third-party providers
- Four MCP tools: discover_tools, inspect_tool and get_tool_run (free, read-only) and run_tool (paid)
- Bundles the 1toolring skill; Agent Plugins v1 package (plugin.json + mcp.json + skills/), configuration only

Disclosures
- Hosted-only connector with no local code: every tool call, with its arguments, goes to mcp.1toolring.com (Streamable HTTP, API key auth).
- run_tool spends the key owner's prepaid 1ToolRing balance at the price inspect_tool shows; failed runs are not charged and there is no subscription.
- The package marks the server untrusted, so Hermes asks before every run_tool call.
- The key is read from ONETOOLRING_API_KEY in the profile .env (or the plugin's settings form) and sent as a bearer header.
- The tool set is served by the remote server at runtime and is not covered by the pinned sha.

entries.name: abeyance
entries.title: Abeyance
entries.description: Your Hermes cron jobs wait for you instead of guessing. When a scheduled run reaches a step that publishes, pushes, merges, deploys, pays, sends a message, deletes in the cloud, writes a database or destroys local work, Abeyance stops that step before it runs (pre_tool_call), keeps the work already done, freezes the run and replaces its delivered output with a card for the owner. Replying `resume CODE` checks the repo and touched files are unchanged since the card (git HEAD, branch, upstream, uncommitted changes, file hashes) and refuses with the exact change if not (pre_llm_call block, no model call); otherwise the agent's first action must be the exact parked call, which goes to Hermes's own approval gate. Single use, owner-only (stable platform ids), expires after 18 h by default, exactly-once. Subagents of a cron run are bound so a held step cannot hide there. Also /abeyance, hermes abeyance (list, show, deny, test, demo), a bundled skill, a Nightly release blueprint and a Desktop half (status chip, Waiting for you page, Resume and Drop). Disclosure — Abeyance runs read-only local git (rev-parse, status) on the host in the cron job's working folder with a minimal environment, user/system git config, core.fsmonitor and hooks off, and skips status when the repo defines filter drivers (including through include.path and config.worktree); it stores parked commands and their arguments verbatim (not redacted), git snapshots and up to 300-character output excerpts in its own SQLite store under the profile's plugin data; it never approves a step itself.
